task_language: Close the electric kettle lid and turn on the electric kettle.
correction_semantics: The robot gripper is going too far below the lever and missing contact with it. Move the gripper to the lever, but very important that it is just above it (not beneath it) so that it can later push it down. Note that the robot gripper will need to go around it, meaning it first comes above the lever and then goes close to it!

selection.reason: Plan 19 moves the gripper towards the lever with a significant leftward movement of +2.0 cm while minimizing the downward movement to only -1.5 cm, keeping it as high as possible to avoid going beneath the lever.
